## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig [1940], SZ-AAL/B1.77a
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.77a
- Datum: 1940
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 2 Scans

pages.transcription:
Thanks for your cable!

I have letters from Friedental, I seems that the poor fellow has a
hard life and as he is merely too proud to ask for help I would like
to ask you to help him substantially; perhaps he could go to the country
and finish his book. Also to Felix Braun 9 Castle Crescent, Kendal,
Westmoreland help would be welcome; he lives with his old mother
there and his sister. Victor has had a new operation, his will to
see his wife in South Africa keeps him alive. I will try to send
them a small food parcel only it is not so easy and we have no
news that a single of those we did send has arrived. I hope you
will both soon enjoy the garden and the well merited holidays
Yours
Stefan
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf einem schmalen Papierstreifen. Die Tinte ist violett. Der Text ist gut lesbar.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr deutlich und gut lesbar. Einzig das Wort 'I' am Anfang der zweiten Zeile scheint ein Schreibfehler des Autors für 'it' zu sein, wurde aber originalgetreu transkribiert.
